# Variables triggers

## Global variable created

Runs when a global variable is saved for the very first time. Global variables are values Cuebot remembers for all actions, like a death counter.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Variable name** | The variable's name without the ~ signs, like "deaths". Empty means any variable. |
| **Persisted** | Either = both kinds. Yes = only variables that are kept after a restart. No = only temporary ones that vanish when Cuebot closes. Options: Either, Yes, No. Starts as: `Either`. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%variableName%` | The name of the variable |
| `%newValue%` | The value it was given |
| `%persisted%` | Whether it is kept after a restart (true or false) |

<small>Type id: `variables.globalCreated`</small>

## Global variable deleted

Runs when a global variable is deleted. Be careful with actions that delete the same variable they are listening for.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Variable name** | The variable's name without the ~ signs, like "deaths". Empty means any variable. |
| **Persisted** | Either = both kinds. Yes = only variables that are kept after a restart. No = only temporary ones that vanish when Cuebot closes. Options: Either, Yes, No. Starts as: `Either`. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%variableName%` | The name of the variable that was deleted |
| `%oldValue%` | The value it had |
| `%persisted%` | Whether it was a kept variable (true or false) |

<small>Type id: `variables.globalDeleted`</small>

## Global variable updated

Runs when the value of an existing global variable changes. Handy to react to a counter, like a message when the death counter reaches a new number.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Variable name** | The variable's name without the ~ signs, like "deaths". Empty means any variable. |
| **Persisted** | Either = both kinds. Yes = only variables that are kept after a restart. No = only temporary ones that vanish when Cuebot closes. Options: Either, Yes, No. Starts as: `Either`. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%variableName%` | The name of the variable |
| `%oldValue%` | What it was before |
| `%newValue%` | What it is now |
| `%persisted%` | Whether it is kept after a restart (true or false) |

<small>Type id: `variables.globalUpdated`</small>

## User variable updated

Runs when a variable that belongs to one viewer changes, like their lucky number or their quiz score. Careful: an action that changes the same variable can run itself again.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Variable name** | The variable's name, like "score". Empty means any variable. |
| **Persisted** | Either = both kinds. Yes = only variables that are kept after a restart. No = only temporary ones. Options: Either, Yes, No. Starts as: `Either`. |
| **User login** | Only react to this viewer, typed like their chat name, for example "kris". Empty means any viewer. |
| **Platform** | Only react to viewers on this site, like twitch, youtube, kick or rumble. Empty means any. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%variableName%` | The name of the variable |
| `%oldValue%` | What it was before |
| `%newValue%` | What it is now |
| `%user%` | The viewer's name |
| `%userId%` | The viewer's id on their platform |
| `%platform%` | The site the viewer is on, like twitch |

<small>Type id: `variables.userUpdated`</small>
